utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what’s the next task?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. Could you help sort the donated parts and label what still needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll sort the donated parts and label anything that still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’d like to know the timing and where everything needs to go first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right — can you confirm the timing and the drop-off spot before we move anything?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes — if you send me the time and exact drop-off spot, I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Sorry, I must’ve missed the details—what’s changing?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: No worries—I’m a bit fuzzy on the details too, but I think they’re just organizing the repairs and making it easier to drop stuff off. I can check and let you know if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that’d be great—thanks. I probably should’ve been paying better attention, but I’d appreciate the update.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to stop by the repair drive later and see what they still need. If you want, I can bring it up with the others too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great, thanks. Let me know what they still need when you get back.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll check in later and tell you what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I’m here—what’s left to do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Glad you made it—there’s still a stack of small fixes to tackle, and I can lend you my tools if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Gus—your tools would help a lot. Point me to the smallest fixes, and I’ll get started right away.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What’s the plan, and what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Eli — that’s great. I’m thinking we start Saturday morning at the community center, and I could use you to help sort tools and match volunteers to jobs.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday morning at the community center works for me. I’ll sort the tools and help match volunteers to jobs.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Sam — are we setting the repair drive date today, or are we still gathering items first?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I think we should set the date today and keep gathering items in the meantime so people have something to plan around.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good — what date should we put on it?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds like a good chance for everyone to pitch in and help out. What part of the repair drive are you thinking about?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m focusing on the drop-off spot and keeping track of who brings what so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s really helpful — I can help keep the list organized if you want, and we can make sure the drop-off spot stays easy to use.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — could you bring a clipboard and some tape, and help me keep track of who signs up? That would be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll bring a clipboard and tape, and I’ll help keep track of sign-ups.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep an eye on supplies for the repair drive. Tell me what you still need, and I’ll check what we’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Cleo — we still need a few basics, like tape, screws, and any spare tools you’ve got. I’ll swing by and check the rest soon.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll set aside the tape and screws I have, and I’ll look through my spare tools for anything useful. Just let me know when you’re coming by.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive’s underway now — folks are dropping off tools and supplies all morning. I can swing by later and let you know what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be great, Tess. I’ll check in later and see where I can help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it — I’ll keep an ear out and report back if they still need hands or haul-offs.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the repair drive details, just so I get everything right before I jump in?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — I’m happy to help, but I don’t have the repair drive details in front of me right now. If you want, I can help you sort out what you need to confirm.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Faye — I’ll confirm the details first and then come back to you.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Just a quick hand with sorting the donated parts and loading them up would be great.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with sorting the parts and loading them up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, I’m happy to help keep everyone on the same page about the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Jules — could you let folks know we’re aiming to sort the repair drive details this week, and I’ll follow up with the exact plan soon?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. What’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ve been keeping it moving, just quietly. I can give you the latest if you want—there’s a bit to sort through.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, please—catch me up. I might’ve missed a few things.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help, Gus — what kind of repair drive are we talking about?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Mostly a quick tool-and-fix drive — folks bring in busted stuff, and I lend whatever gear they need to patch it up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds handy. I can bring a few tools and help out if you want.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the repair drive notes ready, Opal—what do you want me to prioritize first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Let’s start with the locations that need the most urgent repairs, then we can work through the rest by neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds good—I’ll sort the urgent spots first and group the rest by neighborhood. If you’ve got any priority streets in mind, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d want to know the timing, where the drop-off is, and whether we need to bring anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — it’s this Saturday morning at the community center lot, and you can just bring any repair items you’ve got or a basic tool kit if you have one.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds doable, but what time Saturday morning are you thinking? I just want to make sure I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not sure yet, so I’d want to check the details before saying yes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, can you confirm it first and let me know?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for the repair drive—what needs fixing first, and when are you thinking of starting?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I’d start with the safety stuff first, then the smaller fixes after that. If you want, I can help sketch out a simple start time and list for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That would help—let’s start with the safety items and set a simple start time so everyone knows what to do.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve been hearing bits and pieces about the repair drive — what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re still gathering donations and tools for it, and the list is growing nicely. If you hear of any spare supplies, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s good to hear — I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a little scatterbrained today, but I’m happy to help if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Oren — could you help sort the donated tools and label the bins?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely — I can do that. Just point me to the bins, and I’ll start sorting the tools.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup and drop-off. What time is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Faye — it’s set for Saturday morning, around 9 to 11. I’ll send the exact address.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me — I can plan around school pickup then. Send the address when you have it, and I’ll try to help coordinate.
